evidence.reason: At the pinned tip the output guard at line 977 still only checks whether the output path is outside the checkout (`if not outside(output, root):`). It does not verify that each resolved child stays inside the resolved preview root, so a symlinked `systemd`/`launchd` child can redirect preview writes to the live unit directory while still passing the outside-checkout test. This is an ordinary containment bug in the existing write behavior, not a new requirement, and the supplied contract neither retires nor accepts this limitation. The fix is a routine resolved-child containment check; no owner decision is needed.
